items.source: Configures the name of the Neo4jMappingContext bean to be used with the repositories detected.
items.translation: 配置与检测到的仓库一起使用的 Neo4jMappingContext bean 的名称。

items.source: Configures the name of the Neo4jTemplate bean to be used with the repositories detected.

items.source:
Configures whether nested repository-interfaces (e.g. defined as inner classes)
should be discovered by the repositories' infrastructure.
items.translation: 配置是否由仓库基础设施发现嵌套的仓库接口（例如定义为内部类的接口）。

items.source: Specifies which types are not eligible for component scanning.
items.translation: 指定不适用于组件扫描的类型。

items.source:
Configure the repository base class to be used to create repository proxies for
this particular configuration.
items.translation: 配置用于为当前特定配置创建存储库代理的存储库基类。

items.source: Annotation to activate Neo4j repositories. If no base package is configured through either value(), basePackages() or basePackageClasses() it will trigger scanning of the package of annotated configuration class.
items.translation: 用于激活 Neo4j 存储库的注解。如果未通过 `value()`、`basePackages()` 或 `basePackageClasses()` 配置基础包，则将对标注的配置类所在的包进行扫描。

items.source: Alias for the basePackages() attribute. Allows for more concise annotation declarations e.g.: @EnableNeo4jRepositories("org.my.pkg") instead of @EnableNeo4jRepositories(basePackages="org.my.pkg").
items.translation: `basePackages()` 属性的别名。允许使用更简洁的注解声明，例如：`@EnableNeo4jRepositories("org.my.pkg")`，而不是 `@EnableNeo4jRepositories(basePackages="org.my.pkg")`。

items.source: Base packages to scan for annotated components. value() is an alias for (and mutually exclusive with) this attribute. Use basePackageClasses() for a type-safe alternative to String-based package names.
items.translation: 用于扫描已注解组件的基础包。value() 是该属性的别名（且与之互斥）。请使用 basePackageClasses() 作为基于字符串的包名的类型安全替代方案。

items.source: Returns the FactoryBean class to be used for each repository instance. Defaults to Neo4jRepositoryFactoryBean.
items.translation: 返回用于每个存储库实例的FactoryBean类。默认为Neo4jRepositoryFactoryBean。

items.source: Type-safe alternative to basePackages() for specifying the packages to scan for annotated components.
items.translation: 用于指定要扫描以查找已注解组件的包的安全类型替代方案，替代basePackages()。

items.source: Returns the FactoryBean class to be used for each repository instance.
items.translation: 返回用于每个存储库实例的 FactoryBean 类。

items.source: Alias for the basePackages() attribute.
items.translation: `basePackages()` 属性的别名。

items.source: Type-safe alternative to basePackages() for specifying the packages to scan for annotated components. The package of each class specified will be scanned. Consider creating a special no-op marker class or interface in each package that serves no purpose other than being referenced by this attribute.
items.translation: 用于指定要扫描以查找已注解组件的包的 basePackages() 的类型安全替代方案。将扫描每个指定类的包。建议在每个包中创建一个特殊的无操作标记类或接口，其唯一用途是被此属性引用。

items.source: Specifies which types are eligible for component scanning. Further narrows the set of candidate components from everything in basePackages() to everything in the base packages that matches the given filter or filters.
items.translation: 指定哪些类型有资格进行组件扫描。进一步缩小候选组件的范围，从 `basePackages()` 中所有内容限定为与给定过滤器或过滤器匹配的基础包中的所有内容。

items.source: Returns the postfix to be used when looking up custom repository implementations. Defaults to Impl. So for a repository named PersonRepository the corresponding implementation class will be looked up scanning for PersonRepositoryImpl.
items.translation: 返回用于查找自定义仓库实现的后缀。默认值为 Impl。因此，对于名为 `PersonRepository` 的仓库，系统将扫描以查找对应的实现类 `PersonRepositoryImpl`。

items.source: Configures the location of where to find the Spring Data named queries properties file. Will default to META-INFO/neo4j-named-queries.properties.
items.translation: 配置查找 Spring Data 命名查询属性文件的位置。默认值为 `META-INFO/neo4j-named-queries.properties`。
